description: Guard rails for the local OpenCode agent worker. Read by src/lib/agent-policy.ts (dashboard API) and scripts/agent-worker.mjs (executor) so both enforce the same rules.

dangerPatterns.reason: Dropping or truncating database objects destroys data.
Recursive deletion of a drive root or home directory is irreversible.
Repository deletion is irreversible and needs explicit approval.
Infrastructure creation and destruction changes live, billable systems.
Creating or increasing spending needs explicit approval.
